people.name: Hosah
people.line: A Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Shimri
people.line: Levite gatekeeper during David's reign, son of Hosah.

translations.web: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
translations.bsb: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first),
translations.kjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
translations.asv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief, (for though he was not the first-born, yet his father made him chief),
